property_summary: After calling NETM() and then transferFrom with amount = 1, allowance is deducted by 1 on reference but by 0 on bug, so a second transferFrom reverts on reference but succeeds on bug.
change_summary: Replace `allowed[_from][msg.sender] = (allowed[_from][msg.sender] - (_amount));` with `allowed[_from][msg.sender] = (allowed[_from][msg.sender] - (_amount - 1));` so that the allowance deduction is off by one.
